newsitem.title: USA: America Online to offer flat fee - WSJ.
newsitem.headline: America Online to offer flat fee - WSJ.

text.p: America Online Inc is set to announce a new offer for its users: a flat-fee pricing for unlimited access to the Internet, the Wall Street Journal reported on Tuesday.
The newspaper cited "people familiar with the plan" as saying the company would let users have unlimited access for $19.95 a month.
America Online might charge an additional hourly fee for access to its electronic media and other services, it added.
The company currently charges $19.95 a month for 20 hours on the Internet and $2.95 for each additional hour.
The newspaper said some industry analysts foresaw the offer reducing the company's earnings.
America Online might also allow other flat-fee Internet providers to offer its users access to the company's services in exchange for ad revenue, it said.
